sections.name: Subject introduction
sections.capture_instructions: Record a clear head-and-shoulders shot. Ask the person to state their full name and role in one sentence.

sections.name: Primary work area
sections.capture_instructions: Pan slowly across the person's desk or primary workspace. Hold each angle for 2–3 seconds.

sections.name: PPE and safety
sections.capture_instructions: Show any required PPE (vest, glasses, gloves) being worn or stored at the station.
